Macro commodities ratio

Gold/Oil Ratio

This ratio shows how many barrels of WTI crude oil are equivalent to one ounce of gold. A rising ratio means gold is strengthening relative to oil; a falling ratio means oil is strengthening.

Loading Gold/Oil Ratio data…

Why macro investors watch this ratio

The Gold/Oil ratio is a classic macro indicator. When the ratio is high, gold is expensive relative to oil — often seen during periods of financial stress or low energy demand. When the ratio is low, oil is relatively expensive, often during periods of strong economic activity.

Some analysts use extreme readings of this ratio as contrarian signals for positioning in either commodity. It can also reflect relative inflation expectations between financial assets and energy markets.
